panel.title: How to make a Price Check
panel.text:
Not sure what your item is worth? Click **Get a Price Check** below.

🔍 **Search this forum first.** If your item is already here, vote on it with 💸 instead of posting a new one.

The form has two short steps:
**1. Your Price Check:** a title and your item's details
**2. Details:** why you need help, plus required pictures

Your post is titled with your item's name, wear and pattern, tagged, and posted here for the team to review. Other users can vote with 💸 or ❌.

fields.label: What's your question?
fields.description: Keep it short. This is the headline of your post.
fields.placeholder: e.g. Is this a Tier 2 blue gem?

fields.label: Provide sticker, charm & slab info
fields.description: One per line, with type and condition (% scraped).
fields.placeholder:
e.g. 2x Titan Kato 14 (paper) 0%
1x CLG MLG 14 (holo) 10%
Butane Buddy #53243

fields.label: Item Features
fields.placeholder: Pick up to 3 features that apply to your item (Optional)

fields.label: Provide hold information
fields.placeholder: e.g. Tradable now / Tradable in 4 days

fields.label: Any extra details? (optional)
fields.placeholder: e.g. Does this pattern count as a Tier 2 Blue Gem, and how much over market should I expect?

fields.label: In-game and CS2 inspect screenshots
fields.description: Don't forget to attach your in-game and CS2 inspect menu screenshots before hitting post!

author_close.text: -# Happy with the answers? Press **Mark as priced** to close your price check.
